headline: WENDY sings 'Before Sunrise' on KBS 'The Seasons'
sub: Red Velvet's main vocal visits longtime idol Sung Si-kyung's show
caption:
WENDY brought her new title track 'Before Sunrise' to KBS 'The Seasons' on Nov 27.

The Red Velvet member told host Sung Si-kyung she has long been a fan, even buying his concert tickets herself, and looked back on how an audition she went to with a friend kicked off her singing career. KBS also shared an unaired clip of her singing 'Written In The Stars'. 'Before Sunrise' leads her 4th mini album 'Gleam Hour', out since Nov 23.

📌 Source: KBS 'The Seasons', via Korean media
